arxiv-2102-01086.title: Catalog-free modeling of galaxy types in deep images
arxiv-2102-01086.creator: F. Livet, T. Charnock, D. Le Borgne, V. de Lapparent
arxiv-2102-01086.description: Abstract Context. Current models of galaxy evolution are constrained by the analysis of catalogs containing the flux and size of galaxies extracted from multiband deep fields. However, these catalogs contain inevitable observational and extraction-related biases that can be highly correlated.

arxiv-2309-17365.title: Grain boundary segregation and phase separation in ceria-zirconia from atomistic simulation
arxiv-2309-17365.creator: Tom L. Underwood 1,2, Susanna Vigorito 3, Marco Molinari 3, John Purton 4, Nigel B. Wilding 5, John T. S. Irvine 6, Stephen C. Parker 1
arxiv-2309-17365.description: Abstract Doping is the most common strategy employed in the development of new and improved materials. However, predicting the effects of doping on the atomic-scale structure of a material is often difficult or limited to high-end experimental techniques. Doping can induce phase separation in a material, undermining the material’s stability.

arxiv-2407-09297.title: Learning Distances from Data with Normalizing Flows and Score Matching
arxiv-2407-09297.creator: Peter Sorrenson, Daniel Behrend-Uriarte, Christoph Schnörr, Ullrich Köthe
arxiv-2407-09297.description: Abstract Density-based distances (DBDs) provide a principled approach to metric learning by defining distances in terms of the underlying data distribution. By employing a Riemannian metric that increases in regions of low probability density, shortest paths naturally follow the data manifold.

arxiv-2412-14082.title: Modulating Low-Power Threshold Optical Bistability by Electrically Reconfigurable Free-Electron Kerr Nonlinearity
arxiv-2412-14082.creator: Huatian Hu gbsn(胡华天), Gonzalo Álvarez-Pérez, Antonio Valletta, Marialilia Pea, Michele Ortolani, Cristian Ciracì
arxiv-2412-14082.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Huatian Hu gbsn(胡华天), Gonzalo Álvarez-Pérez, Antonio Valletta, Marialilia Pea, Michele Ortolani, Cristian Ciracì. Efficient active control of optical nonlinearity has long been a critical goal for advancing nonlinear optoelectronic devices. However, this remains a significant challenge, as nonlinear susceptibilities are inherently dictated by the microscopic properties of materials. In this work, we propose a microscopic mechanism to electrically reconfigure the Kerr nonlinearity by modulating the concentration of free electrons in heavily doped semiconductors under a static bias.

arxiv-2501-18924.title: Language Games as the Pathway to Artificial Superhuman Intelligence
arxiv-2501-18924.creator: Ying Wen, Ziyu Wan, Shao Zhang
arxiv-2501-18924.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ying Wen, Ziyu Wan, Shao Zhang. The evolution of large language models (LLMs) toward artificial superhuman intelligence (ASI) hinges on data reproduction, a cyclical process in which models generate, curate and retrain on novel data to refine capabilities. Current methods, however, risk getting stuck in a data reproduction trap: optimizing outputs within fixed human-generated distributions in a closed loop leads to stagnation, as models merely recombine existing knowledge rather than explore new frontiers.

arxiv-2503-18382.title: PP-FormulaNet: Bridging Accuracy and Efficiency in Advanced Formula Recognition
arxiv-2503-18382.creator: Hongen Liu, Cheng Cui, Yuning Du, Yi Liu, Gang Pan
arxiv-2503-18382.description: Abstract Formula recognition is an important task in document intelligence. It involves converting mathematical expressions from document images into structured symbolic formats that computers can easily work with. LaTeX is the most common format used for this purpose. In this work, we present PP-FormulaNet , a state-of-the-art formula recognition model that excels in both accuracy and efficiency.

arxiv-2504-17313.title: Tokenizing Stock Prices for Enhanced Multi-Step Forecast and Prediction
arxiv-2504-17313.creator: Zhuohang Zhu, Haodong Chen, Qiang Qu, Xiaoming Chen, Vera Chung
arxiv-2504-17313.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zhuohang Zhu, Haodong Chen, Qiang Qu, Xiaoming Chen, Vera Chung. Effective stock price forecasting (estimating future prices) and prediction (estimating future price changes) are pivotal for investors, regulatory agencies, and policymakers. These tasks enable informed decision-making, risk management, strategic planning, and superior portfolio returns. Despite their importance, forecasting and prediction are challenging due to the dynamic nature of stock price data, which exhibit significant temporal variations in distribution and statistical properties.

arxiv-2505-24343.title: Minimising the numerical viscosity in Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics simulations of discs
arxiv-2505-24343.creator: Cheng Chen, C. J. Nixon
arxiv-2505-24343.description: Abstract Simulations using the Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH) technique typically include numerical viscosity to model shocks and maintain particle order on the kernel scale. This numerical viscosity is composed of linear and quadratic terms, with coefficients α SPH \alpha_{\rm SPH} and β SPH \beta_{\rm SPH} respectively.

arxiv-2507-10513.title: Characterization of Upper-Level Undergraduate Quantum Mechanics Courses in the U.S.
arxiv-2507-10513.creator: Jesse Kruse, Molly Griston, Bethany R. Wilcox
arxiv-2507-10513.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jesse Kruse, Molly Griston, Bethany R. Wilcox. Upper-level, undergraduate quantum mechanics (QM) is widely considered a difficult subject with many varied approaches to teaching it and considerable variation in content coverage. For example, two common approaches to undergraduate QM instruction are spins-first, which focuses on the postulates of QM in spin systems before discussing wavefunctions, and wavefunctions-first, which focuses on the Schrödinger equation and its solutions for continuous functions in various potentials before discussing spin.

arxiv-2509-20682.title: Addressing Gradient Misalignment in Data-Augmented Training for Robust Speech Deepfake Detection
arxiv-2509-20682.creator: Duc-Tuan Truong, Tianchi Liu, Junjie Li, Ruijie Tao, Kong Aik Lee, Eng Siong Chng
arxiv-2509-20682.description: Abstract In speech deepfake detection (SDD), data augmentation (DA) is commonly used to improve model generalization across varied speech conditions and spoofing attacks. However, during training, the backpropagated gradients from original and augmented inputs may misalign, which can result in conflicting parameter updates.

pmc-11429068.title: Utility of IMP3, p53, and S100P immunohistochemical stains in distinguishing reactive atypia from dysplasia in cholecystectomy specimens
pmc-11429068.creator: Evan Sica, Karen T. Shore, Limin Yang, Kara Chan Phelps, Suntrea T. G. Hammer, Purva Gopal, Dipti M. Karamchandani, James Michael Mitchell
pmc-11429068.description: BackgroundDistinguishing reactive atypia from dysplasia in cholecystectomy specimens can be histologically challenging. The aim of this study was to evaluate the utility of IMP3, p53, and S100P immunostains in differentiating reactive atypia from dysplasia in cholecystectomies.MethodsFifty-four cholecystectomies were reviewed and characterized into 5 groups: 2 normal, 29 reactive atypia, 16 low-grade dysplasia, 2 high-grade dysplasia, and 5 adenocarcinoma.

pmc-11516083.title: Loneliness in Baltic-Nordic Older Adults Amid COVID-19
pmc-11516083.creator: I Reine, M Miķelsone, S Tomsone, H Guðmundsson, A Ivanovs, H S Guðmundsson, I Koroļeva
pmc-11516083.description: BackgroundThe study investigates loneliness among older adults in the Baltic-Nordic region, particularly in the context of the COVID-19 pandemic. It aims to understand how loneliness varies across cultural and socio-economic contexts in these areas, which is critical for developing public health strategies tailored to the specific needs of older populations.

pmc-12639305.title: Evaluation of black soldier fly larvae frass on broiler performance and meat yield, quality, and sensory characteristics
pmc-12639305.creator: NM Beckman, HG Walters, BJ Bench, S Cho, A Morey, J Valenta, SJ Rochell
pmc-12639305.description: Insect meal is an alternative feed ingredient of interest due to its nutrient content and sustainability potential. Frass (BSFLF) is produced during black soldier fly larvae meal and consists of larval excreta, exoskeleton sheddings, and leftover larval feedstocks that may be a viable feed ingredient for broilers.

pmc-13094035.title: Tracheobronchial foreign body aspiration in Palestinian children in the West Bank: a 10-year retrospective analysis
pmc-13094035.creator: Ahmad Zohud, Heba Khuffash, Qamar Hamarsheh, Masara Samara, Reem Sawafta, Nisreen Rumman, Iyad Maqboul, Wafa ’ Awad, Mousa Akram
pmc-13094035.description: BackgroundForeign body aspiration (FBA) is a frequent pediatric emergency with potentially serious complications. This study examines the clinical features, diagnostic challenges, and outcomes of FBA in children in the West Bank, Palestine, over 10 years, to fill a regional data gap and support improved prevention and management strategies.

pmc-13136494.title: Impact of γ-aminobutyric acid and 1-methylcyclopropene on qualitative attributes of apples (Malus domestica Borkh. cv. Fuji) during cold storage
pmc-13136494.creator: Yanqing Dang, Yanju Xiang, Adila Abudula, Xujie Hou, Yunfeng Pu
pmc-13136494.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study investigated the efficacy of γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA, 1.0 mM) and 1-methylcyclopropene (1-MCP, 1 µL L− 1), individually and in combination, in mitigating watercore disappearance, flesh browning, and postharvest quality in apples during 180 days storage. The results showed that the combined GABA + 1-MCP treatment outperformed individual applications, significantly delaying watercore disappearance by preserving sucrose and sorbitol while moderating glucose and fructose accumulation.

pmc-13381182.title: Are attitudes toward music therapy associated with lower social anxiety in university students? The roles of emotion regulation and psychological flexibility
pmc-13381182.creator: Pingting Li, Xiong Gao
pmc-13381182.description: BackgroundSocial anxiety in university students is a mental health risk and is linked to various psychological resources. Emotional regulation and psychological flexibility are related to how students manage distress. This study explores how these factors are associated with the relationship between attitudes toward music therapy and social anxiety in students.

pmc-13478226.title: The application of traditional machine learning and deep learning with EEG for mild cognitive impairment: a bibliometric analysis

[FR Doc No: 97-8726] ----------------------------------------------------------------------- DEPARTMENT OF THE TREASURY Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request March 31, 1997.
